li.label: A crimson sky over the wastes
li.text: Beneath the blood-red sun of the Eclipse, the Rift above the continent groans like tearing steel. Gravity fluctuates around the Spark Resonator, compass needles spin wildly, and every faction leader in the wasteland is marching toward {COLONY} for the final summit before the machine is engaged.

li.label: Eve of the final summit
li.text: The Spark Resonator hums at critical harmonic pitch while armed delegations approach your perimeter. Whether backed by your recruited defectors or your colony's own veteran engineers, your Borax countermeasures and perimeter wards stand ready. How do you prepare the waystation for the leaders' arrival?

li.label: Stand beside the Zero Synth at the console and reinforce the Enochian wards
li.resultText: Blue light steadies inside the Resonator's crystal as the Zero Synth breathes evenly beside you. Outside the gates, the first motorcades and vertibirds descend through the crimson haze.

li.label: Prime the Borax sprayers, load heavy turrets, and put the garrison on hair-trigger alert
li.resultText: Heavy bolts clack home across your battlements. Every faction leader entering {COLONY} will see immediately that you intend to dictate terms from strength.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: summit beneath the blood sun: defenders

li.label: The defenders' council
li.text: Preston Garvey, Desdemona, and the Winchester brothers gather in your waystation hall alongside wary observers from the Brotherhood and Vault-Tec. Preston sets his hat on the table: "We came because you swore to protect the living. Name the alliance that will stand at that console when the Rift tears wide open."

li.label: Pledge to unite the Minutemen, Hunters, and Railroad around the Spark
li.resultText: Desdemona and Preston exchange a firm nod. The coalition of the Free Wasteland stands ready at your command.

li.label: Hear out the Brotherhood and Vault-Tec observers before locking the console
li.resultText: You listen to every final pitch in silence. Every faction leader takes their place around the Resonator chamber for the irreversible vote.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: summit beneath the blood sun: iron & ash

li.label: Warlords in the hall
li.text: Arthur Maxson's power armor rattles the floorboards as he faces Colonel Autumn and Henry Casdin across your waystation table, while a lone Railroad courier watches from the shadows. Maxson slams his gauntlet down: "Humanity's hour of reckoning is here. Will you purge this world with steel—or with the Enclave's poison?"

li.label: Confirm that {COLONY} is ready to cleanse the wasteland once and for all
li.resultText: Maxson and Autumn both nod curtly, each expecting you to side with their vision when the Resonator powers up.

li.label: Demand guarantees that innocent settlers and the Zero Synth won't be butchered
li.resultText: Maxson scowls coldly, while the hidden Railroad courier catches your eye—leaving the door open for a dramatic last-minute reversal.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: summit beneath the blood sun: architects

li.label: Heaven and the Architects
li.text: Blinding celestial light dims the lanterns as Archangel Michael steps into your waystation beside Dr. Hess, while Father and Dr. Braun wait by the comms terminal. Michael speaks with absolute certainty: "Earth has bled in chaos for two centuries. Surrender the Sparks to Heaven's Host, and we shall impose eternal peace."

li.label: Acknowledge that only absolute higher authority can save this broken world
li.resultText: Michael inclines his head in solemn approval as the delegations file toward the Spark Resonator.

li.label: Compare Heaven's terms against the Institute and Vault-Tec proposals
li.resultText: Dr. Braun smiles thinly from the corner while Michael's eyes narrow. The final decision awaits at the console.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: summit beneath the blood sun: lords of night

li.label: Drinks at the edge of the Pit
li.text: The air in the waystation reeks of brimstone and expensive cologne as Crowley swirls a glass of scotch across from Dick Roman and the Alpha Vampire. Crowley grins wickedly: "The angels are starving, the humans are terrified, and the Resonator is primed. Tell us, darling—are we cracking open Hell's cellar tonight, or cutting a corporate deal?"

li.label: Raise a glass to shattering the Cage and unleashing the Dark Covenant
li.resultText: Crowley clinks his glass against yours with a triumphant laugh as the entourage moves toward the Resonator.

li.label: Remind everyone that {COLONY} controls the switch—and demand their best offers
li.resultText: Dick Roman chuckles approvingly at your cutthroat instincts. Everything comes down to the console now.

li.label: Totality of the Blood Eclipse
li.text: The crimson sun locks directly over {COLONY}. Lightning arcs between the Spark Resonator's gold filaments and the storm clouds above. There can be no more stalling—the moment you engage a coalition protocol on the main console, the world's alliances will be forged in stone forever.

li.label: Point of No Return #2: Choose Your Final Coalition
li.text: Every eye in the chamber is fixed on your hands above the Spark Resonator's main control levers. This choice is ABSOLUTE AND IRREVERSIBLE: your chosen coalition will become your permanent allies until the end of the war, while all opposing factions will turn into mortal enemies forever.\n\nWhich coalition will shape the fate of Earth?

li.label: [Free Wasteland] Ally with Minutemen & Hunters + Railroad — seal the Rift and shield all Sparks (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: You lock in the Harmonic Containment Protocol! Preston Garvey, the Winchesters, and Desdemona take their stations beside the Zero Synth—while Heaven, Hell, the Enclave, and the Institute declare total war on {COLONY}!

li.label: [Free Wasteland] Break from the purists and ally with Minutemen & Hunters + Railroad (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Turning your back on the warlords at the final second, you engage the Harmonic Containment Protocol! Desdemona and Preston Garvey rally to defend the Zero Synth as the Enclave and Brotherhood storm out in fury!

li.label: [Sterile Empire] Ally with Enclave + Institute — sterilize mutations and reclaim Earth (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: You engage the Sterilization Matrix! Colonel Autumn and Father clasp hands over the console as plasma cohorts and synth strike teams mobilize to cleanse the wasteland!

li.label: [Sterile Empire] Ally with Enclave + Institute — impose human technocratic order (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Rejecting celestial overlords, you lock in the Sterilization Matrix with Colonel Autumn and Father! Synth legions and Hellfire squads rally to {COLONY} as angels and hunters declare war!

li.label: [Iron Crusade] Ally with Brotherhood + Outcasts — suppress all magic and rogue tech (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Arthur Maxson and Henry Casdin bury their schism at your console! The Resonator shifts into a continental dampener as the reunited steel order marches to purge anomalies, synths, and demons!

li.label: [Iron Crusade] Ally with Brotherhood + Outcasts — shield humanity behind walls of steel (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Believing only armored discipline can hold back the Rift, you unite Arthur Maxson and Henry Casdin under the Iron Crusade! The Institute, Heaven, and Hell mobilize to crush {COLONY}!

li.label: [Celestial Order] Ally with Heaven + British Men of Letters — rekindle grace and impose divine peace (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Blinding golden fire erupts from the Resonator! Archangel Michael and Dr. Hess assume command of the celestial relay network, while Hell, the Brotherhood, and the surface rebels vow to burn {COLONY} to ash!

li.label: [Celestial Order] Turn from the Pit at the last hour and ally with Heaven + Men of Letters (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Refusing to plunge Earth into sulfur and ash, you kneel before the Resonator and pledge the Sparks to Archangel Michael and Dr. Hess! Demons shriek in fury as Heaven's Host descends to guard your gates!

li.label: [Dark Covenant] Ally with Hell + Monster Clans — feed the Sparks to the Pit and rule the twilight (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Crimson lightning shatters the chamber ceiling! Hell's lords and the nocturnal clans bind their blood pact to {COLONY}'s Resonator—plunging the wasteland into eternal twilight as Heaven and humanity march to destroy you!

li.label: [Shadow Consortium] Ally with Vault-Tec + Gunners — monopolize the Resonator and buy the wasteland (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Dr. Braun and Captain Wes sign the executive charter right on the Resonator housing! Mercenary battalions and Vault security deploy around {COLONY} as zealots and rebels prepare a massive assault!

li.label: [Shadow Consortium] Cut a cold corporate pact with Vault-Tec + Gunners to hold the line (IRREVERSIBLE)
li.resultText: Choosing hard contracts and mercenary firepower over idealism, you lock in the Shadow Consortium protocol with Dr. Braun and Captain Wes! Half the wasteland brands you a traitor—and prepares to march!

li.label: The Die Is Cast
li.text: The Spark Resonator's harmonic beam has locked onto your coalition's frequency. Across the wasteland, coups erupt inside rival factions and rejected heroes draw their blades—the Night of the Long Knives has begun.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: night of the long knives: coups

li.label: Shockwaves across the factions
li.text: Within hours of your choice at the Resonator console, encrypted emergency channels light up with news of bloody internal coups across the region's superpowers.

li.label: New masters on the thrones
li.text: In the Institute, hardline director Justin Ayo seizes absolute security control—ordering total eradication of all surface synths. Meanwhile, in the depths of Hell, the absence of Crowley's restraint triggers a catastrophic breach of Lucifer's Cage!

li.label: [Crowley Defected] Brace for Lucifer's wrath as the Archangel of the Pit takes Hell's throne
li.resultText: Crowley pours himself a stiff drink in your mess hall, pale beneath his smirk: "Well, darling... my former employees just let the boss out of the basement. Lucifer is running Hell now, and he's coming straight for us."

li.label: [Crowley in Hell] Log the intelligence intercepts on Justin Ayo and Hell's war council
li.resultText: Your comms officer records the new enemy command frequencies: Justin Ayo rules the Institute's synth legions, while Crowley mobilizes Hell's crossroads demons for total war.

li.label: [Dark Covenant] Coordinate with Hell's war council as Michael and Maxson unite against you
li.resultText: With Hell allied to {COLONY}, infernal scouts report that Archangel Michael and Elder Maxson have formed an emergency crusade to destroy your Resonator.

li.label: Teleportation signature detected
li.text: Justin Ayo wastes no time testing your perimeter: Coursers and heavy synth shock troops are locking onto {COLONY}'s courtyard to eliminate your leadership before your new coalition can reinforce you.

li.label: Courser vanguard shattered
li.text: Your garrison cut down the Institute's elite vanguard in the courtyard, proving your defenses can withstand high-tech precision strikes.

li.label: Heavy damage from synth raiders
li.text: The Courser strike team inflicted severe casualties before teleporting out, leaving your mechanics scrambling to repair the perimeter.

li.label: Salvaging the battlefield
li.text: Smoking synth chassis and shattered pulse emitters litter your courtyard. Your technicians can strip the fallen Coursers for advanced components or broadcast their defeat across the Institute's relay band.

li.label: Strip the fallen Coursers for plasteel and high-grade components
li.resultText: Your engineers harvest valuable pre-war alloys from the wreckage to reinforce your defenses.

li.label: Broadcast a warning to Justin Ayo over his own Courser transponder
li.resultText: The Zero Synth watches the transmission go out with quiet pride—{COLONY} will not bow to the Institute.

li.label: Ambush on the supply road
li.text: Enraged by your alliance with the purists, Railroad heavy Glory and veteran militia fighters have seized a vital supply junction outside {COLONY}, challenging your commanders to face them on open ground.

li.label: Junction cleared
li.text: In a brutal firefight at the junction, Glory fell fighting to the last round—breaking the Railroad's blockade of your supply lines.

li.label: Blockade abandoned
li.text: Before your main force arrived, Glory's squad rigged the junction with charges and melted back into the underground network.

li.label: Bloody stalemate
li.text: Your strike team was forced to pull back under heavy minigun fire, though Allied reinforcements soon drove the rebels away from the road.

li.label: Counting the cost
li.text: Silence falls over the scorched highway junction. Even your hardened officers recognize the grim reality of the Night of the Long Knives: former friends are now mortal enemies.

li.label: Order your squad to secure the rebel weapons and march back to {COLONY}
li.resultText: Your troops recover valuable heavy ammunition and return behind your walls to prepare for the final war.

li.label: Black ichor at the gates
li.text: Refusing to let {COLONY} ruin their centuries-old harvest, Leviathan enforcers and feral night-stalkers surge out of the crimson fog—testing whether your Borax defenses are truly ready for the final war.

li.label: Leviathan strike broken
li.text: Hissing clouds of white Borax mist dissolved the Leviathans' invulnerability, allowing your defenders to cut them down before they reached the Resonator!

li.label: Brutal midnight clash
li.text: The Leviathan pack tore through your outer barricades before withdrawing at dawn—make sure every squad carries Borax sprayers before the final siege!

li.label: Columns of searing light
li.text: Enraged that {COLONY} aligned with the Pit or the Consortium Board, Zachariah leads an angelic strike force down through the crimson clouds to smite your Resonator chamber.

li.label: Angelic strike repelled
li.text: Your Enochian wards and heavy weapons drove back Heaven's punitive squad, leaving scorched feathers and shattered celestial steel across the courtyard.

li.label: Scorched battlements
li.text: Heaven's strike force burned half your outer defenses before retreating—reinforce your Enochian wards before the main armies arrive!

li.label: Quiet before the storm
li.text: A heavy, unnatural calm settles over {COLONY} after the Night of the Long Knives. Colonists sharpen blades, check power-armor seals, and share quiet words around the dining tables while the Spark Resonator pulses steadily.

li.label: Last words before war
li.text: You find the Zero Synth standing quietly beside the Resonator, gazing into the blue crystal. Whether bound to you by deep trust or wary necessity, they know the final act is about to begin.

li.label: Hold a quiet toast with your defenders and reaffirm your resolve
li.resultText: Glasses clink in the dim light. Whatever tomorrow brings, {COLONY} will face it unbroken.

li.label: Inspect the armory and distribute final emergency medical kits
li.resultText: Every squad receives fresh trauma kits and ammunition. Your settlement is ready for total war.

li.label: Allied vanguard arrives
li.text: Supply drop-pods and ranger outriders from the Minutemen, Hunters, and Railroad arrive at {COLONY}, bringing heavy munitions and salt-forged wards. Preston Garvey salutes crisply: "The Free Wasteland stands with you, General. Our scouts have located the first Enochian beacon sites—say the word, and we launch our campaign!"

li.label: Accept the allied war chest and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Signals flash across every allied settlement. The final campaign for a free wasteland begins now!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Preston Garvey has joined your garrison alongside Free Wasteland war supplies! Your first coalition war quest—raising the Shield of Salt and Steel—is now unlocked.

li.label: Enclave & Institute task force arrives
li.text: A black Enclave vertibird touches down in a column of Institute teleportation lightning, delivering plasma ordnance and Captain Richards to reinforce your command. Richards snaps to attention: "Colonel Autumn and Father have synchronized the atmospheric dispersal grid. Give the order, and we begin cleansing the wasteland!"

li.label: Accept the imperial war chest and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Orbital relays lock onto resistance strongholds. The campaign to forge the Sterile Empire begins!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Captain Richards has joined your garrison alongside Enclave and Institute war materiel! Your first coalition operation—Toxic Horizon—is now unlocked.

li.label: Reunited steel corps arrives
li.text: Heavy Brotherhood and Outcast supply pods slam into your landing zone, bringing uranium cores, plasteel armor plates, and master quartermaster Specialist Olin. Olin adjusts her welding goggles with a grim grin: "Maxson and Casdin finally stopped arguing long enough to ship the heavy iron. Point us at the Institute and the monsters!"

li.label: Accept the crusade armory and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Vertibird engines roar across the blood-red sky. Ad Victoriam—the Iron Crusade marches to war!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Specialist Olin has joined your garrison alongside Brotherhood and Outcast war supplies! Your first coalition operation—Hammer and Anvil—is now unlocked.

li.label: Heaven's liaison & London's arsenal arrive
li.text: In a flash of blinding white light, angelic intelligence officer Naomi appears beside supply cases stamped with the British Men of Letters crest. Naomi folds her hands calmly: "Archangel Michael and Dr. Hess have authorized full support for your garrison. Together, we shall harvest the Sparks and bring eternal order to Earth."

li.label: Accept the celestial reliquary and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Enochian beacons flare across the horizon. The campaign of the Celestial Order begins!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Naomi has joined your garrison alongside Heaven and Men of Letters supplies! Your first coalition mission—Harvest of Sparks—is now unlocked.

li.label: Emissaries of the Pit & Night arrive
li.text: Black smoke coils across your courtyard as rebel-turned-enforcer Meg steps forward with blood packs, pre-war gold, and demonic war-chests from Hell and the Monster Clans. Meg smirks darkly: "Hope you're ready to get your hands dirty, boss. The Pit and the Alpha's packs are locked and loaded—let's go burn Heaven's gates down."

li.label: Accept the infernal tribute and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Sulfur winds howl across the crimson wasteland. The Dark Covenant rides to war!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Meg has joined your garrison alongside tribute from Hell and the Monster Clans! Your first coalition mission—Blood Tithe—is now unlocked.

li.label: Corporate drop-pods & elite sniper arrive
li.text: Heavy Vault-Tec cargo containers touch down in your courtyard alongside Gunner master marksman Baker, carrying bullion, plasteel, and pre-war components. Baker checks his scope calmly: "Dr. Braun's transfer cleared, and Captain Wes has our battalions staged along the ridge. Tell us which competitors get liquidated first."

li.label: Accept the Consortium capital and launch Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.resultText: Contract orders flash across mercenary frequencies. The hostile takeover of the wasteland begins!

li.label: Act V: Armageddon of the Wastes
li.text: Baker has joined your garrison alongside Vault-Tec and Gunner war capital! Your first coalition operation—Hostile Takeover—is now unlocked.
